Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 459/2019

Dear Mr. Ghosh,

Thank you for meeting us on 18 October 2019 about your dispute with Shalini Chatterjee. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 1,95,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
